purpose: Measure simulator execution time and files saved by observation I/O optimization while preserving original full-native completion, release, retreat, reset, and independent five-sample acceptance.

history_review.reason: 原生200例使用环境目标判据；复用模型输入和成功步数，不重复基线。
完整碗抽屉在线在视觉纠错超时前阻断；旧动作回放验证退离/home，复用其执行器和筛查。
复用完整原生技能规划、一次独立复核及能力覆盖说明。

Existing simulator baseline: bowl execution 152.7734s and chain execution 392.1394s; all four full native skills passed independent 5/5 and handoff. Reuse native completion evidence and original timing; compare only changed observation I/O.

related_search: Reuse original prior history and registered 20261014-sim-fast matching question; original successful bowl/chain evidence supplies latency and all-four-skills acceptance baseline.
hypothesis: Eliminating unused periodic captures and repeated same-state captures reduces simulator observation I/O while preserving original acceptance.
information_gain: New I/O timing, capture/cache counts and file sizes against existing original evidence; model RNG is not paired, so causal speed cannot be isolated from action-count differences unless those are checked.
success_criteria: Optimized path actually skips captures and cache_hits>0; original synchronized release wrist/agentview/sideview images present; native trigger>0, actual release_open_actions/movement/home>0; independent five-sample acceptance, next reference, queue/proprio/controller resets and all previous goals pass; execution VLM calls=0 and planning calls=2 recorded. Record monotonic stage timings, action/capture/cache counts and file sizes.
failure_criteria: Expected branch not triggered or actual target actions zero means trigger-chain failure and target effect unverified; stop dependent validation. Executed actions with acceptance failure are effect failures. Preserve original failures and never automatically rerun.
unknown_criteria: Missing evidence, startup/network/interface failure or unpaired model RNG/action-count differences remain unknown; no claim of causal speed or native reliability from one case.

changed_factors.name: execution_observation_io
changed_factors.before: Periodic unused history captures, repeated force observations, and extra external 512px views on every geometry capture
changed_factors.after: No unused periodic history; same-state observation cache; extra external 512px views on release only
changed_factors.reason: Measure redundant simulator observation I/O reduction with original completion and control path preserved.

fixed_factors.planning: qwen3.8-max joint three-view planning plus one independent review; two calls

scope.stop_rule: Maximum one case, no automatic rerun. If first bowl target branch is not triggered, actual actions zero or acceptance fails, stop dependent chain. During chain any expected trigger/action/acceptance failure stops later skills; preserve evidence.

configuration.request: 把桌上的碗放进最下层抽屉并关上抽屉
configuration.native_instruction: put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it
configuration.model_rng: existing service default, not paired deterministic comparison
configuration.entry: normal console load/plan/execute APIs; selected checker_mode simulator

repeat.reason: Compare new I/O against existing original evidence, not establish a new native success-rate baseline.
